Scope: All actual 8 post and 3 spacer solids against one another and all non-fastener Top geometry, including native MB1224, forks, legs, nested cage and optics.
All 8 actual fork-anchor head solids against all other Top geometry, including other complete anchors; own complete anchor excluded.
Hidden occurrences are included. Suppressed occurrences are recorded and excluded. Native nested occurrence transforms are composed from their actual definitions.
ExplicitExclusions: M4 screw major-thread envelopes are not tested against tapped post, spacer or optic holes.
Fork-anchor threaded shanks are not tested against MB1224 tapped holes; their actual heads are tested against the board and all other geometry.
Optics versus optics and internal supplier-body mechanical clearances are outside this support audit.
Non-solid source bodies cannot provide closed-solid intersection volume and are listed separately.
